notes: Desktop 3.17.0 (Desktop Cycle 3, D9): git depth. Hunk staging in the diff view: stage, unstage or discard individual hunks, with a stale-selection guard that re-reads the diff and refuses if it changed since it was loaded. A three-pane conflict editor: base, ours and theirs panes beside an editable result, per-conflict Use ours / Use theirs / Use both buttons, a live conflicts-remaining counter, and save (write + stage) blocked while markers remain unless explicitly overridden; the Git panel banners merge, rebase and cherry-pick state and says when the operation is ready to commit, without ever committing or continuing for you. Desktop 3.16.0 added the model store. Android stays 3.10.1; its next release re-syncs the shared version train.
